feeds.title: Midland Warriors » Women's Flag Football
feeds.description: Read all about women's flag football at Midland University. Midland Warriors is the official home of Midland University athletics which publishes the latest information about sports, schedules, athletes, fans, recruitment, notes, ticketing, and more.

feeds.title: Florida HS Football » Flag Football
feeds.description: We deliver information on high school football and girls flag football across Florida. Featured on our website are news stories, up-to-date schedules, live game scores, the Florida HS Helmet Project, and a whole lot more! We also work with strategic partners to maximize the exposure for high school athletes and their teams around Florida.

feeds.title: Global News » Flag Football
feeds.description: Catch up with the most recent news articles, videos, and events in the flag football world. Global News offers a host of news and information, from breaking news in the community to deep, engaging content that puts complex world issues in perspective. Our coverage features stories and analyses about issues in Canada and abroad.

feeds.title: Camrose Buffaloes Football Blog
feeds.description: Receive the latest news and updates about the Camrose Buffaloes Football Association. We are a youth football organization run by a Board of Volunteers with the aim of having our players learn the game, have fun, and compete to the best of their ability. Our novice flag program is designed to develop skills, provide a basic understanding of football terminology, and will allow players to expand their skills.

feeds.title: NIRSA » Flag Football
feeds.description: NIRSA provides the latest news, in-depth analysis, championship alerts, and more on flag football. NIRSA is involved in higher education and advocates for the advancement of recreation, sport, and wellness by providing educational and developmental opportunities, generating and sharing knowledge, and promoting networking and growth for its members.

feeds.title: American Flag Football League
feeds.description: Get news on games, teams, events, and players in the American Flag Football League! The AFFL is a preeminent professional flag football organization that offers youth and women's competition, and in 2023, it is supposed to launch a men's professional division. It also aims to build a worldwide community of fans and players who will be united by their shared values through Flag Football.

feeds.title: FirstDown PlayBook » Adult Flag Football
feeds.description: Discover articles on strategies, formations for defense, reverse pass, smash, seam, and more.PlayBook Tech is a sports software company that helps coaches at all levels spend more time developing football players and less time consumed with designing plays.
